title: Yoisaki Kanade — From Feeling To Melody〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you for waiting, Enanan. I finished checking your artwork and I think what you came up with should work.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa, Enanan's never been this productive before. Is the world about to end or something?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What are you talking about? Anyways, I want to focus, so I'm putting everything on mute.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Fine, be that way. I was just having some fun...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But I'm glad Enanan's back to her usual self.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Me too. She's taking Amia's jokes much better now too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, hold up. Why am I the bad guy all the sudden?! I'm not trying to be mean or anything!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that Ena feels better now. I need to thank Rin for delivering our song to her too.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I feel like Ena will be just fine now...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But my art's just an accessory for the song...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Now that I think about it, I didn't explicitly say that she's wrong then...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Me three! So let's get started then♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, before we do...
Enanan, can you take a look at this?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Got it. Let's download and... Huh?
This is all stuff that I drew...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, it is! Wow, some of it's like a blast from the past too!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It is. These lines and brush strokes weren't very clean...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What?! Why is it that you can only say stuff like that?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, settle down now. I get that you two want to talk, but K does too so...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you, Amia. Um, let's start by looking at the first one then.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa, this one's from forever ago! You know, I never really get tired of seeing this girl and her floral hair piece.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Right. The girl's body is turned the other way, but the background and flowers on her hair piece make you think about what sort of expression she may have.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <This was from when we made that song that made very different impressions on each person that listened to it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That was why I wanted you to draw something that reflected that and also had the same effect. In the end, it matched perfectly with the song.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But I remember that I took too long designing the whole thing and made us upload later than usual.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No, this was definitely worth the time. There's also...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The next file is... The boy that's vanishing with the rain, and how each rain drop represents the voices of the people around him, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. I really liked this one too and had a lot of fun while drawing it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Come to think of it, you were really on a roll that time and made a ton of other stuff too.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Um, I'm happy that you appreciate my art... But is this what you wanted me to see?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes... I thought that I should actually tell you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That your artwork isn't just an accessory.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I talked to Yuki and Amia about this earlier too...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Our songs can reach so many people because they have artwork that instantly tells them what they're about.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That's why I thought I should tell you that your art makes our songs happen.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Of course it did... Thank you, K.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thanks. And sorry for the wait, Yuki, Amia. We should get started.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, it was fun to see this stuff again after so long♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<And Enanan...
We're definitely counting on you.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Right. You can leave N25's artwork to me!>
